### (a) Three posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem humanity faces. From clean energy to resilient infrastructure, we see a future defined by solutions.

2. We stand for building superintelligent AI within the next 20 years. If we achieve that milestone, it will solve every major engineering problem humanity faces. We want to turn humanity’s hardest technical challenges into finished work.

3. We reject the idea that humanity’s greatest engineering challenges must remain unsolved. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will solve them all. We are committed to making that future real.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem humanity faces. We mean every one: producing abundant clean energy, delivering safe water, building resilient infrastructure, and developing the technologies needed to restore our environment. We see these challenges not as permanent limits, but as problems awaiting sufficient intelligence and the means to put solutions into practice. That conviction drives our work. We stand for the research, investment, and responsible development needed to reach this milestone. We are working toward a future in which humanity’s greatest engineering obstacles become achievements—and we intend to help build it.
